children: The number of employed people in the United Kingdom climbed by 102 thousand to 34.577 million in the three months in August 2026, sharply exceeding forecasts for a gain of 20 thousand and following a 66 thousand increase in the previous period.
The increase in employment was largest since May, reflecting continued growth in full-time workers that partly offset a decline in part-time employment.

title: UK Employment Rises Above Forecasts
